Let the circles have radii r1, r2 and center distance d.

Internal tangent length: d² − (r1+r2)² = 361.
External tangent length: d² − (r1−r2)² = 1369.

Expected XY²: for X on ω1 and Y on ω2, with centers O1, O2, E[XY²] = d² + r1² + r2² (the cross terms vanish on averaging).

Subtracting the two tangent equations: (r1+r2)² − (r1−r2)² = 4r1r2 = 1369 − 361 = 1008, so r1r2 = 252.

Adding them: 2d² − 2(r1²+r2²) = 1730, so d² − (r1²+r2²) = 865.

Combined with d² + r1² + r2² = 2023: adding gives 2d² = 2888, so d² = 1444 and d = 38.

Check: r1²+r2² = 2023 − 1444 = 579. Then (r1+r2)² = 579 + 504 = 1083, and d² − 1083 = 361 ✓. (r1−r2)² = 579 − 504 = 75, and 1444 − 75 = 1369 ✓.

ANSWER: 38
